source_caption:
Avengement (2019) follows Cain Burgess, a hardened criminal who escapes from prison and returns to his hometown with one goal: to find the people responsible for destroying his life.
After years of brutal treatment behind bars, Cain has become a completely different man. He tracks down his former associates and forces them to confront the betrayal that sent him down a path of violence and suffering.
As Cain searches for answers, the story reveals the events that shaped him and the choices that turned his life into a nightmare. Every encounter brings him closer to the people he believes are responsible, while also forcing him to confront the consequences of his own actions.
The movie explores themes of betrayal, revenge, survival, loyalty, violence, and redemption. Cain's journey is not simply about getting even—it is about confronting the people and circumstances that changed him forever.
What makes Avengement compelling is its raw, relentless action and the personal nature of Cain's mission. Every fight carries the weight of years of anger, pain, and betrayal.
💬 After everything they took from him, Cain came back with nothing left to lose.

source_details.title: Avengement
source_details.synopsis: Avengement is a 2019 British action thriller film directed by Jesse V. Johnson who co-wrote the film with Stu Small. The film stars Scott Adkins, Craig Fairbrass and Thomas Turgoose. Avengement was released on 24 May 2019 on VOD and in selected theatres, where it received generally positive reviews from critics with praise for its action choreography and Adkins' performance. In 2020, a special edition was released, which contains an uncut version of the film.
